# Synthetic Git source archives

`git-archives.json` contains base64-encoded gzip tar archives generated by Git **2.39.5** from a new synthetic repository. It contains no downloaded repository, credentials, or personal configuration. `base_sha` and `head_sha` identify the deterministic fixture commits.

The commit archives exercise Git's global PAX `comment` record, directory names ending in `/`, short and full commit suffixes on GitHub-style wrapper directories, and executable file modes. The second commit adds a 120-byte filename, producing a per-entry PAX `path` override and Git's hashed placeholder header. The subtree archive intentionally has a legitimate `src/` root that must not be stripped.

Regenerate using the locally installed pinned native image:

```sh
docker run --rm -i --network none --read-only \
  --user 65532:65532 --cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges \
  --tmpfs /tmp:rw,nosuid,nodev,size=32m,mode=1777 \
  --entrypoint /usr/bin/env shipmunk-codex-native-test:local \
  -i PATH=/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin HOME=/tmp \
  /usr/local/bin/node --input-type=module \
  < runner/tests/fixtures/source-archive/generate.mjs \
  > runner/tests/fixtures/source-archive/git-archives.json
```

Run `go test ./internal/workspace -run 'TestPrepareGitSourceArchivesAndTrustedInstructions|TestExtractGitArchiveVariants'`. The fixture proves compatibility with real Git archive headers without calling GitHub. Separate negative cases construct valid tar checksums around hostile PAX records to verify traversal, unsupported metadata, duplicates, malformed lengths, and extraction limits. Source normalization checks use the recorded manifest revision; an arbitrary single-directory archive is preserved.

The extractor intentionally supports global `comment` and per-entry `path` PAX keys only. Sparse-file metadata, links, size overrides, and other extensions remain rejected. File permissions retain owner read/write and the original owner execute bit, with group, other, set-ID, and sticky bits removed.

Git records executable intent from the owner execute bit. A credentialless probe with Git 2.39.5 indexed files with modes `0601` and `0610` as `100644`, and files with modes `0700` and `0711` as `100755`. The permission regressions preserve this distinction while stripping group, other, and privilege bits.
